# The Fiscal Times

> > Independent journalism covering U.S. fiscal policy, economic data, inflation trends, and federal budget issues.

The Fiscal Times provides in-depth analysis and reporting on the American economy, with regular coverage from contributors Yuval Rosenberg and Michael Rainey. The publication focuses on key economic indicators like GDP growth, PCE inflation data, Federal Reserve policy, and fiscal challenges facing the United States.

## Key Topics

- U.S. Economy
- Inflation
- GDP Growth
- Federal Reserve Policy
- Fiscal Policy
- Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE)
- Stagflation
- Economic Data Analysis
- Energy Prices
- Federal Budget
- Commerce Department Reports
- AAA Economic Analysis
- Inflation Insights
- Omair Sharif Economic Commentary
